titles.title: Petunias in Oval

description: Pale pink and lavender-colored petunias sit in an oval composition framed by a brown line. The flowers contrast with a plain, pale blue and white background. The entire oval composition sits on a slightly darker blue background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
